question.text: The correct statement <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mfenced></math> related to the metal extraction processes is(are)

options.text: A mixture of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>PbS</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>PbO</mi></math> undergoes self-reduction to produce <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Pb</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>SO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>.</mo></math>
In the extraction process of copper from copper pyrites, silica is added to produce copper silicate.
Partial oxidation of sulphide ore of copper by roasting, followed by self-reduction produces blister copper.

In cyanide process, zinc powder is utilized to precipitate gold from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Na</mi><mfenced open="[" close="]"><mrow><mi>Au</mi><msub><mfenced><mi>CN</mi></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math>

solution.text:
A PbS+PbO→Pb+SO2

It is self-reduction reaction.

B In the extraction process of copper from copper pyrites, silica is added to produce Iron silicate.

C Partial oxidation of sulphide ore of copper by roasting, followed by self-reduction produces blister copper.

Cu2S+O2→Cu2O+SO2

Cu2S+2Cu2O→self−reduction6Cu+SO2

D Zn+2NaAuCN2→Na2ZnCN4+2Au
